summary.verdict: HELD-OUT VALIDATION HOLDS — on K. pneumoniae (a WHO pathogen the method NEVER saw in development), the NEWBUG FBA-essentiality predictions are enriched for INDEPENDENT EXPERIMENTAL (CRISPRi/Tn-seq) essentiality at odds ratio 63.1 (Fisher p=3.5e-16), precision 92%. So the experimentally-validated mechanism signal is NOT confined to development organisms — it holds on a genuinely held-out pathogen (the north-star claim), now against experimental truth. THREE-ORGANISM picture: E. coli OR 64, Mtb OR 7.9, K. pneumoniae (held-out) OR 63.1. HONEST BOUNDS: binary enrichment validated; recall 25% (FBA metabolic-scoped); continuous AUROC 0.62; experimental label is an aggregation of published K. pneumoniae essentiality studies (verified experiment-backed, 2 non-experimental rows excluded); essentiality only, not drug-target/clinical. COVERAGE CAVEAT: only 483/1927 of our genes were adjudicable (gene-symbol-mappable into the experimental table; strain-proteome versions differ so direct-accession overlap is 0) — that subset skews toward well-annotated core genes, so the association is valid WITHIN it but not a whole-proteome estimate.
